description_full:
Finally, the wait is over! 🚀 MagangHub Batch 3 is officially OPEN! ❤️

Ready to kick-start your career? This is your chance to gain real-world experience and grow with LOTTE through the MagangHub program by the Ministry of Manpower of the Republic of Indonesia.

Explore various internship opportunities across our Head Office and Stores, from Design & Media, HR, Finance, Data Analyst, Retail Operations, and more!

✨ What's waiting for you?
- Professional Mentorship
- Real Industry Experience
- Monthly Stipend
- Employment Social Security
- Official Internship Certificate
- Free Lunch
📅 Registration: October 31 – November 4, 2026

Don't miss your chance! Check the requirements, choose your preferred role, and get ready to apply!

🔗 Register now at: maganghub.kemnaker.go.id

Your next career journey starts here. See you at LOTTE! ❤️
